description: Correct one NPC, monster, location, spell, item, faction or action in an owned session recap. Get entry ids from chargen_get_session_recap. Omitted or null fields preserve values. For actions, summary edits the prose and interaction_links replaces the complete list; [] clears interactions. Actor identity is read-only. To remove an entry use chargen_delete_recap_entry. For transcript renames use chargen_preview_find_replace.

interaction_links.description: Action only: complete desired interaction list; [] clears, omitted/null preserves

location_ids.description: Entry UUIDs from this same recap

monster_ids.description: Entry UUIDs from this same recap

npc_ids.description: Entry UUIDs from this same recap

summary.description: Action summary only; empty clears, omitted/null preserves

name: chargen_edit_recap_entry
title: Edit session recap entry
